skill.name: Wind Style - Gale Palm
skill.desc: Deals damage and <font color="#4dc831">4 Combo</font> to up to 6 units in the opponent's lineup, causes <font color="#4dc831">Low Float</font> to the selected unit. If the selected unit has a <font color="#4dc831">Shield</font>, this skill will change to: Deals damage and <font color="#4dc831">4 Combo</font> to all units in the opponent's lineup and cancels all <font color="#4dc831">Buffs</font> and <font color="#4dc831">Shields</font> from all units hit.
